text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Captivating the crowd with a powerful 
run, it's Mihono Bourbon!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAHH--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Bourbon lost, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, but I really couldn't look away! Her 
presence? No, that's not quite it—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seeing how she stayed true to 
herself and worked so hard to get this far 
really touched my heart!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So it's "unfulfilled" after all, huh. No, 
but still—what an incredible run...!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I want to see... where Mihono Bourbon's 
path leads next...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't claim victory, the 
applause from Mihono Bourbon's fans was 
deafening.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Classic Triple Crown... 
This is the Satsuki Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master... I am terribly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Report: Triple Crown unachieved. I... 
fell short...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I've... shattered their 'dream'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she stands there frozen, she doesn't 
seem to hear the voices of the people 
around her, captivated by her running.
choice_data_list: Try listening to the voices around you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My... voice...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Missing the Triple Crown is a shame, yeah, 
but that was still an incredible run, 
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............ My running has an impact on 
the hearts of others――?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list:
Even if you lose, there's always something 
to be gained.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status 『Bizarre』 has occurred. What on 
earth... should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you can't capture the Classic 
Triple Crown, even if you remain 
crownless—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running through the Classic Triple Crown 
will surely be a plus for Mihono Bourbon.
choice_data_list: Let's run through to the end together!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Together... until the very end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes, previously wavering with 
anxiety, look straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A round of applause honoring her valiant 
effort surrounds Mihono Bourbon. The 
excitement from the stands showed no signs 
of stopping for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Bourbon-san's running... was 
incredible... Everyone's eyes were glued 
to her...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't 'reach' them at all...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"But of course they would... Because 
Rice... has always been so 'amazing'..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice has to change properly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night. After returning home from 
Nakayama Racecourse, she said she wanted 
to run a bit, so when we went to the 
track—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...! *pant*... 
*sniff*...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice-san is training. In addition, 
'tears' have been detected. What on 
earth—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*splat*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower tumbled to the ground. Without 
thinking, I stop Mihono Bourbon as she 
tries to rush over.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, Master...
choice_data_list: Let's watch over them a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a short while, Rice Shower stood up, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*... *sob*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, she started running once more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice... Rice is going to... become much 
stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"One day, without fail... I'll catch up... 
to Bourbon-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master. I am not adept at interpreting 
emotions. What was the meaning behind 
that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I haven't won the Satsuki Sho. Just what 
am I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she had said 
something similar before.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wishes she could become like that in 
the Twinkle Series too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can say goodbye to the Rice 
Shower that brings misfortune to 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It didn't look like Rice Shower was 
competing against Mihono Bourbon—it seemed 
more like she admired her, chasing after 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps burdened by that longing, she just 
couldn't be satisfied with her own 
running.
choice_data_list: I'm sure she's just feeling frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling... "frustrated"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon murmured, seemingly still 
not quite grasping what was meant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm concerned about Rice Shower, too... 
Even so, I can't just spend all my time 
worrying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the Japan Derby. I psyched 
myself up once more.
